name: Decision Journal
description: Writes a structured decision journal entry capturing the decision, context, constraints, options considered, chosen option with rationale, predicted outcomes, and a scheduled review date. Produces the complete journal entry, not advice about journaling. Use when the user asks about documenting a decision, creating a decision record, building a decision log, or tracking decisions for future review. Do NOT use for making the decision itself (use weighted-decision-matrix or pro-con-analysis), business strategic decision documentation (use business strategy skills), or project change control (use scope-creep-management).
